hooks.statusMessage: git diff + status vor dem Commit...
hooks.command:
INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$CMD" in *"git commit"*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; DIR=$(printf '%s' "$CMD" | sed -n 's/.*cd \([^ &;]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); WORKDIR="${DIR:-.}"; DIFF=$(cd "$WORKDIR" 2>/dev/null && git diff --stat 2>/dev/null); STATUS=$(cd "$WORKDIR" 2>/dev/null && git status --short 2>/dev/null); jq -cn --arg d "${DIFF:-<keine Aenderungen>}" --arg s "${STATUS:-<clean>}" --arg w "$WORKDIR" '{systemMessage: ("Pre-commit-Check in " + $w + ":
=== git diff --stat ===
" + $d + "
=== git status --short ===
" + $s)}'
